select v.* from (select hm.bp_id, hm.bp_code, hm.bp_class, hm.bp_name, hm.REGISTER_CERT_NUM, hm.bp_category, (select bc.description from hls_bp_category bc where bc.bp_category = hm.bp_category) bp_category_n, hm.bp_type, (select sc.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v sc where sc.code = 'BP.BP_MASTER_ROLE' AND sc.CODE_VALUE = hm.bp_type) bp_type_n, (select max(ma.bp_attachment_id) from hls_bp_attachment ma where ma.bp_id = hm.bp_id) bp_attachment_id, t.verify_id, t.phone_number, t.person_name, t.receive_phone_number, t.id_number, t.check_time, t.open_time, t.legal_open_time, to_char(trunc(t.check_time), 'yyyy-mm-dd') check_time_format, to_char(trunc(t.open_time), 'yyyy-mm-dd') open_time_format, to_char(trunc(t.legal_open_time), 'yyyy-mm-dd') legal_open_time_format, nvl(t.sign_check_status, 'N') sign_check_status, (SELECT sv.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sv WHERE sv.CODE = 'SIGN_CHECK_STATUS' AND sv.code_value = nvl(t.sign_check_status, 'N')) sign_check_status_n, t.sign_enabled_flag, (select bv.meaning as value_name from sys_code_value_b_v bv where bv.code = 'SYS.YES_NO' and bv.code_value=t.sign_enabled_flag) as sign_enabled_flag_n, t.operate_user_id, (Select wm_concat(hm1.bp_name) From hls_bp_master_relation t1, hls_bp_master_relation t2, hls_bp_master hm1 Where t1.bp_id = hm.bp_id And t1.relation_type = 'VENDER' And t2.bp_id = t1.related_bp_id And t2.relation_type = 'MANUFACTURER' And hm1.bp_id = t2.related_bp_id) vender_name, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = t.operate_user_id) operate_user_id_n, (select fu.unit_name from sys_user_allocation sa, fnd_employee_assigns fa, fnd_org_unit fu where sa.user_id = t.operate_user_id and fa.employee_assign_id = sa.employee_assign_id and fu.unit_id = fa.unit_id and fa.primary_position_flag = 'Y') unit_name from prj_sign_verify t right join hls_bp_master hm on hm.bp_id = t.bp_id where exists (select * from hls_bp_master_role hr where hr.bp_id = hm.bp_id and hr.bp_category = 'DEALER') or (hm.bp_class = 'ORG' and exists (select * from hls_bp_master_role hr where hr.bp_id = hm.bp_id and hr.bp_category in ('DEALER', 'TENANT', 'MANUFACTURER', 'VENDER')))) v
and nvl(v.sign_enabled_flag,'N') = #{signEnabledFlag}
and v.verify_id like concat(concat('%',#{verifyId}),'%')
and v.bp_code like concat(concat('%',#{bpCode}),'%')
and v.bp_name like concat(concat('%',#{bpName}),'%')
and v.person_name like concat(concat('%',#{personName}),'%')
and v.vender_name like concat(concat('%',#{venderName}),'%')
and to_date(v.check_time_format,'yyyy-mm-dd') >= to_date(#{checkTimeFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and to_date(v.check_time_format,'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_date(#{checkTimeTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and to_date(v.open_time_format,'yyyy-mm-dd') >= to_date(#{openTimeFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and to_date(v.open_time_format,'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_date(#{openTimeTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and to_date(v.legal_open_time_format,'yyyy-mm-dd') >= to_date(#{legalOpenTimeFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and to_date(v.legal_open_time_format,'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_date(#{leaglOpenTimeTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and nvl(v.sign_check_status,'N') = #{signCheckStatus}
order by v.bp_id desc
select * from ( SELECT sv.* FROM PRJ_SIGN_VERIFY sv where bp_id = #{bpId} and nvl(sv.SIGN_ENABLED_FLAG,'Y') = 'Y' and sv.VERIFY_RESULT = 'SUCCESS' order by sv.open_time desc) where rownum <=1
